seal.statement: Amortize SQL_TRANSACTIONS fresh-seed control fencing across a bounded wave of independent partition cohorts using ONE canonical replica-handler cutover owner. Each dependent cutover still receives a fresh, current, complete-member control verdict before PAUSE and immediately before RESUME. The controller retains exact PAUSE/CLOSED status for the held wave; no previous CUT_OVER, owner snapshot, cached OPEN or seed-local authorization may grant permission. On failure, timeout, membership/generation turnover and restart, all dependent and control obligations remain owned and fail closed.
